CSS
Comments



CSS Comments

Comments are used to explain the CSS code, and may help when you edit the
source code at a later date.

Comments are also used to temporarily disable sections of CSS code within a
stylesheet.

Comments are ignored by browsers!

A CSS comment is placed inside the HTML
<style>
element, and starts with
/*
and ends with
*/
:

You can add comments wherever you want in the code:

Even in the middle of a code line:

Comments can also span
multiple lines:
